answer: I ran the Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The server lists the free mock as "garnet:mock", so I used that name for "garnet-mock". The circuit puts H on q0, then CNOT from q0 to q1, then measures both qubits. The job ID is 01a15f50-e8db-7566-98e3-9a2672d9a746 and it completed. The counts were 00: 20, 01: 22, 10: 34, 11: 24. The counts are spread across all four outcomes because the mock returns random results, as the IQM docs say. A real QPU would give mostly 00 and 11. The mock job used 0 credits. The circuit file is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-337/bell.qasm.
